items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I recorded with Johnson from Brunswick... I've seen some of those recordings with Johnson. Did you solo with him? ... No, never. Just ensemble.

ctx.x: I come in and have a cup of coffee. Were you born here in the city?

Born and raised in New Orleans. Spent a lot of time. I was pleased. Elsewhere, I had my band in New York. I toured with Arnold Johnson under the name of Paul Whiteman's orchestra, which was a misnomer. But we, they only took us because we were too good. We were playing at Martin's Casino in Atlantic City when they heard the band. And Whiteman must have said, I better get this band under my wing. And he did. He also took in the red caps. So I was playing at the Grunewal at the time. And Mr. Grunewal, do you know…
